items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mahalia says, my next song, ladies and gentlemen, was written by a good friend of mine, and I want you to hear it.

ctx.x: Now, I don't know what Mahalia was going to do because I hadn't seen her to talk to her, and when I -- during this concert -- now, this woman and all her friends, this woman -- her record -- the Apollo record company, was sitting in the audience. And I'm sitting there.

Mahalia says, my next song, ladies and gentlemen, was written by a good friend of mine, and I want you to hear it. And she sang that song. She says, written by this lady sitting right here, Alberta Hunter, a good friend of mine, and when she said that, what could Bess Berman do?
